attacks.name: Psychic Dart
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Root|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§root§Root| special condition.

attacks.name: Mental Suggestion
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, this character may Advance the defender its |!speed|.

attacks.name: Astral Duel
steps: Add dice to the attack roll equal to the defender's |!mystic| Defense.
The defender cannot reroll or modify dice in the defense roll during this attack.

superPowers.name: Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters (Affiliation: Uncanny X-Men)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, when an allied character spends 1 or more |!power| to use an |!active| or |!reactive| superpower, after the effect is resolved, another allied character may gain 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Professor's Guidance
superPowers.body: While another allied character within |!range| 4 is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, this character may spend 1-3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each |!power| spent, the allied attacking or defending character may reroll 1 of its dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Telepathic Lock
superPowers.body: When an enemy character targets this character with an attack, it may use its |!mystic| Defense regardless of the attack's type unless the attacker pays 2 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Omega-Level Telepath
superPowers.body: This character cannot be Pushed or Advanced by the effects of |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers.
